transcript.t: Ben, are you going to the tryout for the sports team?
Yes. I want to join the relay team, but I am also trying shot-put.
Only eight now. My goal is twelve.
I am trying out for swimming. The judge will time us in the freestyle race.
You are talented. I am sure you will make it.
Thanks. Neither of us should be nervous.
Right. Let's do our best and enjoy the game.
